title: Provenance Entry
description: A record of a primitive's execution, documenting what ran, when, with what parameters, and on what inputs. Provenance entries accumulate as data flows through the pipeline, creating a complete chain of custody.

primitive.description: Name of the primitive that was executed

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the primitive executed

params.description: Parameters passed to the primitive. Structure varies by primitive.

inputs.description: All inputs consumed by this primitive, with lineage information. Always an array, even for single-input primitives.

name.description: Role this input plays in the primitive

semantic_type.description: Semantic type of the input data, from semantic_types.yml vocabulary

path.description: Path to the input file at time of execution (local path or S3 URI)

hash.description: Fingerprint of input data for reproducibility and tamper detection

value.description: The hash value, or null if hashing was skipped

method.description: How the hash was computed. full_file: complete content hash. metadata: size + mtime + header. skipped: no hash computed.

algorithm.description: Hash algorithm used (present when method is not 'skipped')

reason.description: Why hashing was skipped (present when method is 'skipped')

run.description: The experiment or preparation id whose step made this entry (D-167). Absent on receipts written before D-167.

step.description: The step id, within run, that made this entry (D-167). With run, it lets staleness judge an inherited entry against its own declaration (D-165).

lineage_branch.description: Which input stream contributed this entry to the current envelope's provenance chain. Null for the primitive that created this envelope; named for inherited entries from input envelopes.

publication.description: Contract 1, rule 11 (D-143): what this step changed about what could leave, one record per change, empty when it changed nothing. The primitive gives step, detail and count; by and at are stamped by the builder from this entry. Inherited with the entry, so every descendant carries it.

step.description: What kind of change; the closed set of Contract 1, section 8

detail.description: What exactly: which units, which field, to what precision, which tolerance

count.description: How many units or fields it touched

by.description: The primitive whose entry this is, stamped by the builder

at.description: The entry's timestamp, stamped by the builder
